title: When a Biotech Says No to a Sale: Five Tests of Whether It Can Become a Biopharma
summary: An acquisition is not the only successful outcome for a biotech. Using argenx, Insmed, Incyte, and Revolution Medicines as four operating snapshots, this analysis tests product evidence, cash generation, a second growth curve, global execution, and financing options—and shows what retaining control really costs.
